sources.entry: Mediagoblin - Media publishing platform that anyone can run (alternative to Flickr, YouTube, SoundCloud). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python

summary.name: MediaGoblin
summary.one_liner: MediaGoblin is a free media publishing platform that anyone can run, as a self-hosted alternative to sites like Flickr, YouTube, and SoundCloud.
use_cases: publish images, video and audio on your own server
host audio or video alongside photos
deploy a media sharing site with Docker
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Savannah cgit source-tree listing for the mediagoblin.git repository, showing files such as README.md, configure.ac, Dockerfile variants, docker-compose templates, and setup.py. It shows the project is built with autotools and Python packaging, and includes Docker and Guix build files. The listing itself does not describe features in detail; the awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a media publishing platform for photos, video, and audio that anyone can run. Federation is a branch name in the repository list.
notable: Alternative to Flickr, YouTube and SoundCloud
Licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python
caveats: The page is only a source-tree listing and does not describe features or installation in detail
Platform support beyond Docker and Linux is not stated on this page
